search.engine.web.git_repo.display_name.description: Display name to use in the U.I. for this search engine.
search.engine.web.git_repo.display_name.name: Display Name

search.engine.web.git_repo.description.description: Human-readable description of the search engine.
search.engine.web.git_repo.description.name: Description
search.engine.web.git_repo.description.value: Search file content across one or more remote git repositories. Supports public and private repos via HTTPS or SSH.

search.engine.web.git_repo.default_param.description: List of remote git repository URLs to search. Accepts HTTPS (https://github.com/org/repo) or SSH (git@github.com:org/repo.git) URLs.
search.engine.web.git_repo.default_param.name: Repository URLs

search.engine.web.git_repo.default_param.description: GitHub/GitLab Personal Access Token for cloning private repos. Also settable via LDR_GIT_TOKEN env var. To create a GitHub PAT: Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens → Generate. For private repos grant 'Contents: Read' permission.
search.engine.web.git_repo.default_param.name: Auth Token

search.engine.web.git_repo.default_param.description: Path to SSH private key for SSH-based authentication (optional)
search.engine.web.git_repo.default_param.name: SSH Key Path

search.engine.web.git_repo.default_param.description: Glob patterns to restrict search (e.g. ["*.py", "*.md"]). Empty searches all files.
search.engine.web.git_repo.default_param.name: File Patterns

search.engine.web.git_repo.default_param.description: Maximum number of search results to return
search.engine.web.git_repo.default_param.name: Max Results

search.engine.web.git_repo.reliability.description: Reliability of the Git Repository search engine
search.engine.web.git_repo.reliability.name: Reliability

search.engine.web.git_repo.requires_api_.description: Whether this search engine requires an API key (only needed for private repos)
search.engine.web.git_repo.requires_api_.name: Requires Api Key

search.engine.web.git_repo.requires_llm.description: Whether this search engine requires an LLM for relevance filtering
search.engine.web.git_repo.requires_llm.name: Requires LLM

search.engine.web.git_repo.supports_full.description: Whether this search engine supports full document search
search.engine.web.git_repo.supports_full.name: Supports Full Search

search.engine.web.git_repo.strengths.name: Strengths
value: Fast git grep on cached clones

search.engine.web.git_repo.weaknesses.name: Weaknesses
value: Initial clone can be slow for large repos

search.engine.web.git_repo.use_in_auto_s.description: Include Git Repository in auto search mode
search.engine.web.git_repo.use_in_auto_s.name: Include in Auto Search
